say:1:1221402001:0.source_cn: 欢迎来到锈锚港！外乡人！

choice_prompt:2:1221402001.source_cn: 欢迎来到锈锚港！外乡人！

say:3:1221402002:0.text: You've got manners! There are too many roughnecks here in Rustport. People like you would be a great addition.
say:3:1221402002:0.source_cn: 很绅士风度嘛，锈锚港不缺混蛋，但缺你这样的人。
say:3:1221402002:0.male: You've got manners! There are too many roughnecks here in Rustport. People like you would be a great addition.
say:3:1221402002:0.female: You've got manners! There are too many roughnecks here in Rustport. People like you would be a great addition.

say:4:1221402005:0.text: Here's a free tip for you, newbie—you can't get by in Rustport without some connections.
say:4:1221402005:0.source_cn: 新来的，免费告诉你个消息。在锈锚港这种地方，背后没人可...
say:4:1221402005:0.male: Here's a free tip for you, newbie—you can't get by in Rustport without some connections.
say:4:1221402005:0.female: Here's a free tip for you, newbie—you can't get by in Rustport without some connections.

say:5:1221402006:0.text: So, you know what to do...
say:5:1221402006:0.male: So, you know what to do...
say:5:1221402006:0.female: So, you know what to do...

choice_prompt:6:1221402006.male: So, you know what to do...
choice_prompt:6:1221402006.female: So, you know what to do...

say:7:1221402007:0.text: Sounds crude if you put it that way. Just think of it as a deposit for our future collaboration.
say:7:1221402007:0.source_cn: 别说这么难听，你可以理解为这是合作的订金。
say:7:1221402007:0.male: Sounds crude if you put it that way. Just think of it as a deposit for our future collaboration.
say:7:1221402007:0.female: Sounds crude if you put it that way. Just think of it as a deposit for our future collaboration.

say:9:1221402009:0.text: Trying to blackmail the magister? He's way out of your league, dummy!
say:9:1221402009:0.source_cn: 省省吧，想敲诈我的主人，你还差得远呢。
say:9:1221402009:0.male: Trying to blackmail the magister? He's way out of your league, dummy!
say:9:1221402009:0.female: Trying to blackmail the magister? She's way out of your league, dummy!

say:10:1221402010:0.text: I'm not picking on your boss. All of you need to pay!
say:10:1221402010:0.source_cn: 我不是针对你的主人，我的意思是，你们都要付钱！
say:10:1221402010:0.male: I'm not picking on your boss. All of you need to pay!
say:10:1221402010:0.female: I'm not picking on your boss. All of you need to pay!

say:11:1221402011:0.text: Oh, really? Chippy will "pay" him, Magister!
say:11:1221402011:0.source_cn: 是吗？那么主人，让满满来给他们“付钱”吧！
say:11:1221402011:0.male: Oh, really? Chippy will "pay" him, Magister!
say:11:1221402011:0.female: Oh, really? Chippy will "pay" him, Magister!

choice_prompt:12:1221402011.text: Oh, really? Chippy will "pay" him, Magister!
choice_prompt:12:1221402011.source_cn: 是吗？那么主人，让满满来给他们“付钱”吧！
choice_prompt:12:1221402011.male: Oh, really? Chippy will "pay" him, Magister!
choice_prompt:12:1221402011.female: Oh, really? Chippy will "pay" him, Magister!

say:14:1221402013:0.text: Bring it on! Sir Chippy's dying to see what you've got!
say:14:1221402013:0.source_cn: 来吧！让满满骑士看看你们有什么本事！

choice:12:0:1.text: Pay more. I'm giving this the green light.
choice:12:0:1.male: Pay more. I'm giving this the green light.
choice:12:0:1.female: Pay more. I'm giving this the green light.

choice:6:0:1.text: Are you trying to solicit a bribe?
choice:6:0:1.male: Are you trying to solicit a bribe?
choice:6:0:1.female: Are you trying to solicit a bribe?

say:16:1221402008:0.text: Drop the act already! You know what I'm getting at!
say:16:1221402008:0.source_cn: 别装了，你知道我想说什么！
say:16:1221402008:0.male: Drop the act already! You know what I'm getting at!
say:16:1221402008:0.female: Drop the act already! You know what I'm getting at!

say:17:1221402003:0.text: Come on, you look like you just got off some ship.
say:17:1221402003:0.source_cn: 得了吧，看你这身行头就像是刚刚下船不久。
say:17:1221402003:0.male: Come on, you look like you just got off some ship.
say:17:1221402003:0.female: Come on, you look like you just got off some ship.

say:18:1221402004:0.text: Don't get all frosty with me; I'm just saying hi.
say:18:1221402004:0.source_cn: 别这么冷漠嘛，只是个招呼而已。
say:18:1221402004:0.male: Don't get all frosty with me; I'm just saying hi.
say:18:1221402004:0.female: Don't get all frosty with me; I'm just saying hi.

say:3:1221404001:0.text: Are you here to shake down the Magister too?
say:3:1221404001:0.source_cn: 你也是来讹诈主人的吗？
say:3:1221404001:0.male: Are you here to shake down the Magister too?
say:3:1221404001:0.female: Are you here to shake down the Magister too?

say:4:1221404002:0.text: No, Master Hamster! I'd like to ask for your guidance!
say:4:1221404002:0.source_cn: 不！老师——仓鼠老师！我是来向您请教的！

say:5:1221404003:0.text: M—My name is Karl. I saw your impressive combat skills and would like to learn from you.
say:5:1221404003:0.source_cn: 我、我叫卡尔，我看到了你刚才战斗的英姿，所以才诚心来向...

say:6:1221404004:0.text: Because of my small stature, I've always been bullied. I even tried joining a gang for protection, but no one took me in.
say:6:1221404004:0.source_cn: 我……身体又瘦，胆子还小，总被人欺负。想加入帮派找个靠...

say:7:1221404005:0.text: Do you want Chippy to teach you how to fight?

say:8:1221404006:0.text: Yes, please! I promise I won't stir up any trouble. I just want to defend myself.
say:8:1221404006:0.source_cn: 我……我不会主动惹事的，我只是为了防身。

say:9:1221404007:0.text: Rustport is filled with people like me. I want to learn how to protect them and pass on what I've learned!
say:9:1221404007:0.source_cn: 而且，锈锚港还有不少像我一样的弱者，我想学点本事，保护...

say:13:1221404010:0.text: Let's spar! I'll show you the ropes!
say:13:1221404010:0.source_cn: 我们来对练，我多教你几招！

say:3:1221407001:0.source_cn: 你的领悟能力还是不错的嘛。

say:4:1221407002:0.text: Thanks for the compliment! But I'm still far from ready to take on those bullies...
say:4:1221407002:0.source_cn: 谢谢老师的夸奖！可要打败那些欺负我的人，我还差得远呢……

say:5:1221407003:0.text: You pick up things fast, but it seems to me that... your problem doesn't lie with your combat skills.
say:5:1221407003:0.source_cn: 其实你学得很快，但我觉得……你的问题并不在于战斗技巧。

say:7:1221407005:0.text: You're good at dodging, but you rarely land effective attacks.
say:7:1221407005:0.source_cn: 你很擅长躲避，但有效的攻击却很少。

say:8:1221407006:0.text: Attacking exposes your weaknesses more easily, so novices tend to focus on defense rather than attacking.
say:8:1221407006:0.source_cn: 嗯，攻击意味着容易出现破绽，新人总是更倾向于保守防御而...

say:9:1221407007:0.text: I... am actually just scared. I always think I'm doomed to lose.
say:9:1221407007:0.source_cn: 我……不是保守，应该……就是怂，从小就是这样，总觉得自...

say:10:1221407008:0.text: I'm fine when sparring with you, but if I were up against a real opponent... I'd be trembling with fear.
say:10:1221407008:0.source_cn: 和老师对练还好一点，但如果对面是货真价实的对手……我会...

say:11:1221407009:0.text: That is not okay! Confidence is everything when it comes to combat!
say:11:1221407009:0.source_cn: 这怎么行！作战最重要的就是气势，你要有自信！

say:12:1221407010:0.text: But... confidence's something I just can't seem to learn...
say:12:1221407010:0.source_cn: 可是……自信心，这我可学不会……

say:15:1221407011:0.text: I have an idea! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, don't you have the <style="highlight">Confidence Tonic</style>'s recipe? Shall we let him try it?
say:15:1221407011:0.male: I have an idea! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, don't you have the <style="highlight">Confidence Tonic</style>'s recipe? Shall we let him try it?
say:15:1221407011:0.female: I have an idea! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, don't you have the <style="highlight">Confidence Tonic</style>'s recipe? Shall we let him try it?

choice_prompt:16:1221407011.text: I have an idea! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, don't you have the <style="highlight">Confidence Tonic</style>'s recipe? Shall we let him try it?
choice_prompt:16:1221407011.source_cn: 我有个主意！<style=stress><player_name></style>，你不是有<style=highlight>自信药剂</style>吗，让他试试？
choice_prompt:16:1221407011.male: I have an idea! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, don't you have the <style="highlight">Confidence Tonic</style>'s recipe? Shall we let him try it?
choice_prompt:16:1221407011.female: I have an idea! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, don't you have the <style="highlight">Confidence Tonic</style>'s recipe? Shall we let him try it?

say:17:1221407012:0.text: The one that boosts one's confidence. Remember?
say:17:1221407012:0.source_cn: 哎呀，就是那种能让人增强自信心的药剂，你忘了？
say:17:1221407012:0.male: The one that boosts one's confidence. Remember?
say:17:1221407012:0.female: The one that boosts one's confidence. Remember?

say:19:1221407014:0.text: Confidence Tonic? Hmm... does such a tonic really exist? Why haven't I heard of it?
say:19:1221407014:0.source_cn: 自信？药剂？呃……真的有那种药吗？满满怎么不知道？

say:20:1221407015:0.text: Of course you don't know about it. I'm the expert when it comes to potions!
say:20:1221407015:0.source_cn: 你当然不知道。要说魔药，还是我更在行！

say:24:1221407016:0.text: Confidence Tonic... Can it work for someone like me? Will I become as brave as Master Hamster after drinking it?
say:24:1221407016:0.source_cn: 自信药剂……连我这样的人都可以变得自信吗？只要喝了就能...

say:25:1221407017:0.text: I'm sure you'll become even braver than Chippy!
say:25:1221407017:0.source_cn: 当然，我保证，比你的满满老师还要勇猛得多。

say:26:1221407018:0.text: Really? Please let me try it!
say:26:1221407018:0.source_cn: 真的吗？求你了，请让我试试！

say:27:1221407019:0.text: Sure, we're going to prepare the tonic now. You can wait for us at the dock bazaar.
say:27:1221407019:0.source_cn: 嗯，我们现在要去调制药剂，你在码头集市等我们吧！

say:29:1221407013:0.text: Anyone who drinks it will burst with confidence!
say:29:1221407013:0.source_cn: 只要喝下去，就能让人变得非常自信！

narration:0:1221408001:0.text: We promise to meet Karl later at the dock bazaar. Karl looks excited as he walks away.
narration:0:1221408001:0.source_cn: 我们与卡尔约好稍后在码头集市见面，卡尔兴奋地离开了。

say:0:1221409001:0.text: Hammie, is there really a Confidence Tonic?
say:0:1221409001:0.source_cn: 漫漫，真的有自信药剂吗？

say:1:1221409002:0.text: It's just a placebo. Karl needs to overcome his issues on his own.
say:1:1221409002:0.source_cn: 是安慰剂而已，卡尔的问题得靠自己来克服。

say:2:1221409003:0.text: Let's visit Ornick for the ingredients!
say:2:1221409003:0.source_cn: 我们去找药剂商人找点材料吧！

say:2:1221410001:0.text: What are you looking for? My place's been closed for a while, so I might need some time to restock.
say:2:1221410001:0.source_cn: 药剂？什么药剂？我可很久没开张了，想要的东西可没那么快找到。
say:2:1221410001:0.male: What are you looking for? My place's been closed for a while, so I might need some time to restock.
say:2:1221410001:0.female: What are you looking for? My place's been closed for a while, so I might need some time to restock.

choice_prompt:3:1221410001.text: What are you looking for? My place's been closed for a while, so I might need some time to restock.
choice_prompt:3:1221410001.source_cn: 药剂？什么药剂？我可很久没开张了，想要的东西可没那么快找到。
choice_prompt:3:1221410001.male: What are you looking for? My place's been closed for a while, so I might need some time to restock.
choice_prompt:3:1221410001.female: What are you looking for? My place's been closed for a while, so I might need some time to restock.

say:4:1221410005:0.text: ...I remember you! You're the mage who robbed—I mean, took some supplies off my hands last time.
say:4:1221410005:0.source_cn: ……我想起来了！是你们！之前来我店里抢劫……呃不，带走...
say:4:1221410005:0.male: ...I remember you! You're the mage who robbed—I mean, took some supplies off my hands last time.
say:4:1221410005:0.female: ...I remember you! You're the mage who robbed—I mean, took some supplies off my hands last time.

say:5:1221410006:0.text: Alright... Just pay for whatever you need, and don't blow up my place.
say:5:1221410006:0.source_cn: 行吧行吧……给钱就行，只要别把我的店搞爆炸就可以。

say:7:1221410002:0.text: If there were one, I'd prescribe some for myself.
say:7:1221410002:0.source_cn: 如果有的话，我自己就先吃一剂安慰一下自己了。
say:7:1221410002:0.male: If there were one, I'd prescribe some for myself.
say:7:1221410002:0.female: If there were one, I'd prescribe some for myself.

say:8:1221410003:0.text: We'll get some ingredients and make it ourselves then.
say:8:1221410003:0.source_cn: 那我们还是买些原材料自己调配吧。

choice:3:1:2.text: We don't need the expensive ingredients.
choice:3:1:2.male: We don't need the expensive ingredients.
choice:3:1:2.female: We don't need the expensive ingredients.

say:9:1221410004:0.text: Everything's affordable here. You can get anything you want if you pay.
say:9:1221410004:0.source_cn: 都非常便宜，只要给钱就卖。
say:9:1221410004:0.male: Everything's affordable here. You can get anything you want if you pay.
say:9:1221410004:0.female: Everything's affordable here. You can get anything you want if you pay.

say:2:1221410101:1.text: Yay! I enjoy mixing the ingredients up!
say:2:1221410101:1.source_cn: 耶！我喜欢调配这个环节！

say:3:1221410102:1.text: But... this crucible seems like it hasn't been cleaned in ages. Is it okay to use it?
say:3:1221410102:1.source_cn: 不过这个坩埚……看起来很久没打扫过了，真的没问题吗？

say:4:1221410103:1.text: We don't have time to look for other options.
say:4:1221410103:1.source_cn: 时间不多，我们只能将就下了。

say:1:1221411002:0.text: Let's head to the dock bazaar. Karl must already be waiting for us.
say:1:1221411002:0.source_cn: 走吧，去码头集市，卡尔肯定等急了。

say:3:1221413001:2.text: Is this... the <style="highlight">Confidence Tonic</style> you mentioned earlier?
say:3:1221413001:2.source_cn: 这个……这个就是你们说的<style=highligh...

say:4:1221413002:2.text: Magister made it for you himself. Drink up!
say:4:1221413002:2.source_cn: 这可是主人为了你亲自调制的，快点喝吧。
say:4:1221413002:2.male: Magister made it for you himself. Drink up!
say:4:1221413002:2.female: Magister made it for you herself. Drink up!

say:7:1221413004:0.text: Take it easy. You don't want to choke on it.

narration:9:1221413005:0.text: Karl eagerly downs the tonic, looking forward to the transformation.
narration:9:1221413005:0.source_cn: 卡尔迫不及待地大口吞下药水，满心期待自己充满自信。

say:10:1221413006:0.text: Hmm, not bad! You've become as brave as me now!
say:10:1221413006:0.source_cn: 哼哼，不错！现在你已经跟我一样勇敢了！

say:11:1221413007:0.text: I—I feel an energy surging within my body! Is that what courage feels like?
say:11:1221413007:0.source_cn: 我、我感到身上有一股力量！这就是勇气吗？

say:12:1221413008:0.source_cn: 嗯？你们听到什么声音了吗？

say:13:1221413009:0.text: Sounds like someone's calling Karl's name...
say:13:1221413009:0.source_cn: 好像有人在喊卡尔的名字……

say:0:1221414001:0.text: Karl, you wimp! I finally found you! Haul your butt over here now!
say:0:1221414001:0.source_cn: 卡尔！胆小鬼，原来你躲在这儿！滚过来！

say:2:1221416001:0.text: B—Boss Hamster... I didn't know Karl was your guy. It's my bad...
say:2:1221416001:0.source_cn: 仓、仓鼠大哥……我不知道卡尔跟你混的，对不起……

say:3:1221416002:0.text: No more bullying Karl, otherwise... hmph. You'll be punished by my sword!
say:3:1221416002:0.source_cn: 听着，以后你们不许欺负他！不然的话……哼哼。满满的骑士...

say:4:1221416003:0.text: I won't! I promise! Can I go now?
say:4:1221416003:0.source_cn: 不会不会，绝对不会了！仓鼠大哥，我可以走了吗？

say:8:1221416005:0.text: Thanks, Master Hamster! I feel like I've been reborn!
say:8:1221416005:0.source_cn: 谢谢仓鼠老师！我觉得自己像重生了一样！

say:11:1221416006:0.text: Impressive... Your footwork is light, your body is chubby, and your punches are powerful.
say:11:1221416006:0.source_cn: 不错、不错、真不错……轻盈的步伐，圆润的身姿，碎岩般的重拳。

say:12:1221416007:0.text: Mr. Hamster, I've been observing you for some time. How does being a boxer sound to you?
say:12:1221416007:0.source_cn: 这位鼠先生，我已经观察你一段时间了，你有没有兴趣成为一...

say:13:1221416008:0.text: Boxer? Are you sure I'm the guy you're looking for?
say:13:1221416008:0.source_cn: 拳击手？你是不是找错人了？

say:14:1221416009:0.text: I'm very sure! With your adorable look and powerful strength, we could make a fortune if you sign with me!
say:14:1221416009:0.source_cn: 不，就是你！可爱的外形加上强大的战力，有噱头又有实力。...

say:15:1221416010:0.text: No way! I'll never leave Magister!
say:15:1221416010:0.source_cn: 不要不要，我是绝对不会离开主人的！
say:15:1221416010:0.male: No way! I'll never leave Magister!
say:15:1221416010:0.female: No way! I'll never leave Magister!

say:18:1221416013:0.text: Looks like you guys are a team. Alright then.
say:18:1221416013:0.source_cn: 看来你们是个团队，那好吧。
say:18:1221416013:0.male: Looks like you guys are a team. Alright then.
say:18:1221416013:0.female: Looks like you guys are a team. Alright then.

say:19:1221416014:0.text: I saw everything—how you transformed this youngster from someone who couldn't even throw a proper punch to a motivated fighter. What kind of sorcery is that?
say:19:1221416014:0.source_cn: 我亲眼看到了，旁边这位年轻人受你们指点，这么快就从一个...

say:21:1221416015:0.text: Uh... I'll take that as a compliment.
say:21:1221416015:0.source_cn: 呃……我觉得你最好是在夸我。

choice_prompt:23:1221416015.text: Uh... I'll take that as a compliment.
choice_prompt:23:1221416015.source_cn: 呃……我觉得你最好是在夸我。

say:24:1221416016:0.text: So, that's how you train Mr. Hamster into such a great boxer. I believe you wouldn't mind sharing the recipe?
say:24:1221416016:0.source_cn: 怪不得你可以培养出鼠先生这样的拳击手，你应该不介意分享...
say:24:1221416016:0.male: So, that's how you train Mr. Hamster into such a great boxer. I believe you wouldn't mind sharing the recipe?
say:24:1221416016:0.female: So, that's how you train Mr. Hamster into such a great boxer. I believe you wouldn't mind sharing the recipe?

choice_prompt:25:1221416016.text: So, that's how you train Mr. Hamster into such a great boxer. I believe you wouldn't mind sharing the recipe?
choice_prompt:25:1221416016.source_cn: 怪不得你可以培养出鼠先生这样的拳击手，你应该不介意分享下配方吧？

say:26:1221416017:0.male: Magister, there's no harm in it if it can help more people find their confidence!
say:26:1221416017:0.female: Magister, there's no harm in it if it can help more people find their confidence!

say:27:1221416018:0.text: Awesome! I might not get to work with Mr. Hamster, but this recipe's going to help me train boxers as cute and strong as him!
say:27:1221416018:0.source_cn: 太棒了，虽然无法和鼠先生合作，但有了这个配方，也许我也...

say:28:1221416019:0.text: Here's the payment for the recipe, and I'll get out of your hair now. Thank you!
say:28:1221416019:0.source_cn: 这是购买配方的钱，接下来就不打扰了。谢谢你们，再见。

say:30:1221416012:0.text: I'm not surprised. A talented boxer like him must have a great mentor.
say:30:1221416012:0.source_cn: 我就知道这么优秀的拳击手背后一定有高人指点。
say:30:1221416012:0.male: I'm not surprised. A talented boxer like him must have a great mentor.
say:30:1221416012:0.female: I'm not surprised. A talented boxer like him must have a great mentor.

say:2:1221417001:1.text: Listen, Karl. This is my final lesson for you.
say:2:1221417001:1.source_cn: 卡尔，听好，这是我教给你的最后一课。

say:3:1221417002:1.text: Remember... stop giving people random nicknames! My name's Chippy!
say:3:1221417002:1.source_cn: 最后一课就是……不要给别人乱起外号啊！我叫满满！

say:4:1221417003:1.text: Sorry, Master Ham—I mean, Master Chippy!
say:4:1221417003:1.source_cn: 对不起！仓、啊不！满满老师！

say:5:1221417004:1.text: Karl, here's the money from selling the recipe. It's a little something from me as your master.
say:5:1221417004:1.source_cn: 卡尔，这是刚才卖掉配方的钱，拿着吧，就当是我作为“战斗...

say:6:1221417005:1.text: I can't take it! I haven't even paid you for your lessons!
say:6:1221417005:1.source_cn: 不！老师教我变强，我还没付学费，我不能收钱！

say:7:1221417006:1.text: It isn't just a gift for you! I want you to learn from stronger masters, hone your skills, and protect your loved ones with the money.
say:7:1221417006:1.source_cn: 并不是白白让你收下，你要好好利用这些钱，去拜访更强的老...

say:8:1221417007:1.text: You must become as confident, resilient, and brave as me. Can you do it?
say:8:1221417007:1.source_cn: 你还要变得自信、坚强、勇敢，像满满我一样。怎么样，可以...

say:9:1221417008:1.text: ...That's for sure! I—I believe I can!

say:10:1221417009:1.text: Very well, it's time for us to go.
say:10:1221417009:1.source_cn: 很好，那么，我们该告别了。

say:11:1221417010:0.text: *Sobbing*... I'll keep your words in mind, Master Hamster!
say:11:1221417010:0.source_cn: 呜呜……我会记住您的话，仓鼠老师！

say:12:1221417011:1.source_cn: 我看你根本就没记住！我叫满满！

say:13:1221417012:1.text: Keep up the good work, Karl! Until next time!
say:13:1221417012:1.source_cn: 卡尔，你可要继续努力，再见啦！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1221401002:.text: Yeah, I'm talking to you. Quit looking around!
